annotation.summary: One child gets attention, another struggles nearby, and a skeleton below has been forgotten entirely.
annotation.visual: A mother supports a happy child in a swimming pool while another child struggles at the surface. A lower underwater panel contains a skeleton.
annotation.mechanism: Three levels of neglect turn a simple priority imbalance into an escalating hierarchy of forgotten responsibilities.
scenarios: Prioritize new features while reliability struggles and restore drills are forgotten
Spend attention on the new hobby while older commitments suffer
Fund visible projects and forget invisible maintenance
